measurements.particle_name: Pd-doped PAN core / crosslinked PS raspberry shell nanoplastic
measurements.evidence_quote: Zeta potential and DLS measurements were performed on the Malvern Zetasizer with a disposable folded capillary cell (DTS1070, Malvern) at all sample points of interest. The nanoplastic stock solution was diluted to approximately 0.5 mg/L particle concentration in ultrapure DI H2O || Additionally, both the particle size and zeta potential were stable over the all analysis time points (Table S-2).
